scientific_integrity: Proof and equality constructions are analytic; verify.py performs exhaustive small-state and randomized finite checks, not an infinite-domain certificate. Literature priority has residual uncertainty. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected graphs, irreversible positive-rate threshold adoption, no recovery or exogenous activation. Bound constrains reinforced nonseed adoptions, not their exact locations or times. Positive-rate equivalence assumes time-homogeneous state-dependent transition rates; the zero-rate limit is excluded.
title: A sharp component–cycle budget for reinforced adoption in hybrid social contagion
